blocks.prompt: 6 (i) Find the coefficient of: \(x^5\) in the expansion of \(\left(x^2 - \frac{3}{2x}\right)^{10}\).
blocks.explanation:
Bachon, coefficient us number ko kehte hain jo \(x^5\) ke saath multiply ho raha hai, sign samait. Misaal: \(-7x^5\) mein coefficient \(-7\) hai.
Tareeqa wahi hai jo Sawal 5 mein tha; farq sirf yeh ke aakhir mein sirf number likhna hai.
Plan: general term, \(x\) ki ek power, use 5 ke barabar rakho, \(r\) nikalo, number nikalo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(x^2 - \frac{3}{2x}\right)^{10}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x^5\) ka coefficient.
Tareeqa: \(T_{r+1}\), jahan \(n = 10\), pehla term \(x^2\), doosra term \(-\frac{3}{2x}\). \(x\) dono terms mein hai, is liye powers ko pehle ek karna hoga.

General term aur \(x\) ki power
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{10}{r}(x^2)^{10-r}\left(-\dfrac{3}{2x}\right)^r\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{10}{r}\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)^r\dfrac{x^{20-2r}}{x^r}\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{10}{r}\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)^rx^{20-3r}\]
Kyun: \((x^2)^{10-r} = x^{20-2r}\), power of a power mein indices multiply. Doosre term ko teen hisson mein toda: sign \((-1)^r\), number \(\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^r\), aur \(\frac{1}{x^r}\). \(x^r\) se divide karne par index mein se \(r\) minus hua: \(20 - 2r - r = 20 - 3r\).

\(r\) chunein
\[20 - 3r = 5\]
\[-3r = -15 \Rightarrow r = 5\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki power 5 chahiye. \(r = 5\) whole number hai aur 0 se 10 ke beech hai, to term \(T_6\) maujood hai.

\(r = 5\) rakhein
\[T_6 = (-1)^5\binom{10}{5}\left(\dfrac{3}{2}\right)^5x^{5}\]
\[= -252 \times \dfrac{243}{32}x^5\]
\[= -\dfrac{61236}{32}x^5 = -\dfrac{15309}{8}x^5\]
Kyun: \((-1)^5 = -1\) kyunke 5 odd hai. \(\binom{10}{5} = \frac{10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{5 \cdot 4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 252\). \(\left(\frac{3}{2}\right)^5 = \frac{243}{32}\). \(252 \times 243 = 61236\), aur upar neeche dono ko 4 se divide kar ke \(\frac{15309}{8}\) bana (\(252 = 4 \times 63\), \(32 = 4 \times 8\)).

Coefficient parhein
\[\text{coefficient of } x^5 = -\dfrac{15309}{8}\]
Kyun: Coefficient \(x^5\) ke saamne wala number hai, sign samait.
Dhyan dein: minus sign chhorna aam ghalti hai; coefficient \(-\frac{15309}{8}\) hai, \(\frac{15309}{8}\) nahi.
Tasdeeq: \(15309 \times 4 = 61236 = 252 \times 243\) \(\checkmark\)

blocks.prompt: 6 (ii) Find the coefficient of: \(x^n\) in the expansion of \(\left(x^2 - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{2n}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bracket ki power \(2n\) hai, is liye jawab mein \(n\) aayega. Ghabrayein nahi, tareeqa bilkul wahi hai.
Plan: \(2n\) ke saath general term, \(x\) ki powers ek karo, power ko \(n\) ke barabar rakho, \(r\) nikalo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\left(x^2 - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{2n}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(x^n\) ka coefficient.
Tareeqa: \(T_{r+1} = \binom{2n}{r}(x^2)^{2n-r}\left(-\frac{1}{x}\right)^r\). Dhyan rahe ke yahan binomial ki power \(2n\) hai, \(n\) nahi; is liye \(\binom{2n}{r}\) aayega.

General term aur \(x\) ki power
\[T_{r+1} = \binom{2n}{r}x^{4n-2r}(-1)^rx^{-r}\]
\[= (-1)^r\binom{2n}{r}x^{4n-3r}\]
Kyun: \((x^2)^{2n-r} = x^{2(2n-r)} = x^{4n-2r}\). \(\left(-\frac{1}{x}\right)^r = (-1)^rx^{-r}\). Multiply karne par indices jama: \(4n - 2r - r = 4n - 3r\).

\(r\) chunein
\[4n - 3r = n\]
\[3n = 3r \Rightarrow r = n\]
Kyun: Power \(n\) chahiye. Dono taraf se \(n\) minus aur \(3r\) jama kiya, phir 3 se divide. \(r = n\), jo 0 aur \(2n\) ke beech hai; term \(T_{n+1}\) hai, jo asal mein beech wala (middle) term hai.

\(r = n\) rakhein
\[T_{n+1} = (-1)^n\binom{2n}{n}x^n\]
\[\binom{2n}{n} = \dfrac{(2n)!}{n!\,(2n - n)!} = \dfrac{(2n)!}{(n!)^2}\]
Kyun: \(\binom{m}{r} = \frac{m!}{r!(m - r)!}\) mein \(m = 2n\), \(r = n\) rakha. \(2n - n = n\), is liye neeche \(n! \cdot n! = (n!)^2\).
Dhyan dein: \((n!)^2\) aur \(n^2!\) ya \((2n)!\) mein farq samjhein; yeh teeno alag cheezein hain.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 1\)
\[\left(x^2 - \dfrac{1}{x}\right)^2 = x^4 - 2x + \dfrac{1}{x^2}\]
\[\text{coefficient of } x = -2\]
\[(-1)^1\dfrac{2!}{(1!)^2} = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Chhoti si value par seedha expansion kar ke formula check ho gaya. Is tarah ke general jawab ko hamesha kisi chhoti value se test kar lein.
